title: celtis koraiensis var. aurantiaca
intro: Celtis koraiensis var. aurantiaca, commonly known as Korean Bittersweet, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia, characterized by its yellow-orange berries and dark green leaves. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties, which can help reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and protect against certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of Korean Bittersweet include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve symptoms of respiratory issues, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
